lines.text: Today you will learn the secret map of the stage, and make things fall from the sky.
Every place on the stage has an x and a y.
x goes from minus 240 on the left to 240 on the right. y goes from minus 180 at the bottom to 180 at the top.
The very middle is x 0, y 0.
Go to x and y jumps straight to a spot.
Change y by minus 5 moves down a little. Do it in a loop, and the sprite falls!
Go to x 100, y minus 200: right one square and down two. Pip lands on the star.
Pick random chooses a number for you, like rolling a dice.
Here the apple starts at a random place along the top of the stage — a different place every time.
Put it all together: the apple falls, and if its y gets below minus 170, it jumps back to a random spot at the top.
Now make it rain apples in the Code Lab!
